name: Seacliff Village
description: Seacliff Village is a convenient neighborhood shopping center located on Edinger Avenue in Huntington Beach, California. This community-oriented retail destination serves the local residential area with a practical mix of everyday services and retail stores. Ideally positioned in Orange County, Seacliff Village provides easy access for nearby residents seeking shopping and dining options.
summary: A neighborhood shopping center in Huntington Beach offering convenient access to everyday retail and services for the local community.
